digest.component_or_area: CI/CD workflows, test suite parity verification
propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes a concurrent slot against a GitHub Free org-wide cap of 20 total slots, while performing byte-identical work to _build-and-test.yml:230 with less matrix coverage (single ubuntu/3.12 vs. multiple Python versions and macOS).

All 9 tests in test_core_optionality.py and test_optional.py already run in all four test matrix cells because they carry no pytest markers and conftest.py only auto-marks tests under tests/external/.

Deleting the import-linter job creates an unguarded gap where future contributors could add markers, move files, or apply filters that silently remove those 9 tests from the default suite selection without failing the build.

A durable checked-in test asserting collection of exactly 9 items under default suite selection ('-m "not integration and not external"') is required to prevent accidental removal of optionality coverage.

The import-linter job must be deleted and replaced with a collection guard test in tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py to maintain the optionality guarantee without consuming an extra concurrent slot.
